name: pipeline-debugger-for-redpanda-connect
description: Step a captured batch through a Redpanda Connect pipeline in the VS Code debugger.

rpcnDebug.binaryPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `rpcn-debug` binary that runs debug sessions, for example `<repo>/bin/rpcn-debug`. Machine-scoped, so a workspace can't override it.

cwd.description: The directory that relative paths (pipeline, envFile) resolve against. A relative cwd resolves against the debugger's working directory. When unset, the workspace folder is used.

env.description: Environment variables for the pipeline's ${VAR} interpolations. Values accept ${env:NAME}, which VS Code substitutes from its own environment: reference secrets that way and never put literal secrets in launch.json. Parsed and validated, but not applied yet.

envFile.description: A file of NAME=value environment variables for the pipeline's ${VAR} interpolations. A relative path resolves against cwd, and the file must exist. Keep secrets in this file, not in launch.json. Parsed and validated, but not applied yet.

maxMessages.description: The most messages of the captured batch to step through. The rest of the batch is dropped, never acknowledged, and the Debug Console says how many messages were kept.

pipeline.description: The pipeline YAML file to debug. A relative path resolves against cwd. When unset, the file in the active editor is debugged.
